newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes hover around recent levels.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes hover around recent levels.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market was quiet on Tuesday and enquiries did not improve from their previous levels, traders said.
Despite gains on overnight crude markets, bunker suppliers failed to raise their offers amid poor demand, traders said.

A supplier said he sold one parcel of the 380-cst grade at $97 per tonne on Monday and is raising the offer by $1. The 380-cst grade was quoted at $97/$98 per tonne and the 180-cst was heard at around $104. MDO and gas oil were quoted around $188-$190 and $200-$205 respectively.
